title: Arjuna Vishada Yoga
scene_brief: Arjuna stands in Krishna's chariot at Kurukshetra, seeing relatives and gurus in both armies, overwhelmed by grief and moral confusion before battle.
composition_notes: Foreground: Arjuna dropping Gandiva slightly, trembling. Krishna calm at reins. Midground: Bhishma and Drona visible across war lines. Wide battlefield depth with flags, elephants, and dawn dust.
hook_text: When duty and emotion collide, even the greatest warrior can break.

title: Sankhya Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna begins the timeless teaching of the soul's immortality and disciplined action, while Arjuna listens with intense inner turmoil.
composition_notes: Krishna in radiant authority speaking from chariot seat; Arjuna kneeling, conflicted but attentive. Soft divine aura around Krishna and golden sunrise halo behind.
hook_text: You grieve for what is eternal only because you see through fear.

title: Karma Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna explains the path of selfless action—performing duty without attachment to results.
composition_notes: Krishna gestures toward battling armies to symbolize duty in action; Arjuna regains steadiness, gripping Gandiva with renewed resolve. Dynamic but clean composition.
hook_text: Act with full power—detach from the reward.

title: Jnana Karma Sanyasa Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna reveals divine origins of wisdom and the sacred lineage of this knowledge, connecting cosmic truth with righteous action.
composition_notes: Krishna radiant and majestic, subtle cosmic light patterns behind him; Arjuna watching in awe. Battlefield remains visible but softened for spiritual focus.
hook_text: True action begins where ignorance ends.

title: Karma Sanyasa Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna clarifies renunciation: true freedom comes not from escaping duty, but from inner detachment while acting.
composition_notes: Balanced two-part composition: one side suggests ascetic stillness, the other active battlefield duty; Krishna centered unifying both truths, Arjuna contemplative.

title: Dhyana Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna teaches meditation, mastery of mind, and the disciplined path to inner balance amid chaos.
composition_notes: Arjuna seated in controlled posture inside chariot platform while war atmosphere surrounds him; Krishna guides with calm authority. Visual contrast: inner stillness vs outer conflict.
hook_text: The greatest battlefield is the mind.

title: Jnana Vijnana Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna unveils deeper knowledge of his supreme nature, the material world, and devotion as the path to truly know him.
composition_notes: Krishna luminous with subtle manifestations of nature elements (light, wind, earth tones) integrated elegantly; Arjuna looks upward in reverence.
hook_text: To know the world fully, know its divine source.

title: Akshara Brahma Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna explains the imperishable Brahman, remembrance at death, and the soul's journey beyond worldly cycles.
composition_notes: Celestial horizon blending battlefield with cosmic pathway of light; Krishna points to transcendent sky, Arjuna listens with solemn attention.
hook_text: What you remember at the final moment shapes eternity.

title: Raja Vidya Raja Guhya Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna shares the king of knowledge and deepest secret: all beings rest in him, and devotion reaches the highest truth.
composition_notes: Krishna centered with royal-divine aura, subtle universe symbolism around; Arjuna humbled and devoted. Keep background readable and majestic.
hook_text: The highest truth is both supreme and intimate.

title: Vibhuti Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna describes his divine manifestations present in all excellence, power, and beauty across creation.
composition_notes: Krishna in commanding pose while selective symbolic vibhutis appear in cinematic montage style around him; Arjuna astonished.
hook_text: Every form of greatness is a spark of the Divine.

title: Vishvarupa Darshana Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna grants Arjuna divine sight and reveals the cosmic universal form beyond human imagination.
composition_notes: Epic, overwhelming visual: Krishna transitioning into cosmic form with blazing light and infinite faces/forms motifs; Arjuna in reverent shock. Preserve elegance, avoid clutter.
hook_text: When the universe reveals its true face, certainty shatters.

title: Bhakti Yoga
scene_brief: After the cosmic vision, Krishna teaches loving devotion as the most accessible and intimate path to union.
composition_notes: Tone shifts to warm devotion: Krishna compassionate and close, Arjuna peaceful and surrendered. Golden light and gentle battlefield backdrop.
hook_text: Power bows to love in the path of devotion.

title: Kshetra Kshetrajna Vibhaga Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna explains the field (body-mind nature) and the knower of the field (conscious self), distinguishing matter from awareness.
composition_notes: Conceptual split composition: earthly warrior body imagery vs luminous inner consciousness motif; Krishna instructing with philosophical clarity.
hook_text: Know the field. Become the knower.

title: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna reveals the three gunas—sattva, rajas, tamas—and how they bind the soul to worldly patterns.
composition_notes: Three subtle color energies represented around scene (pure gold, fiery red, deep indigo) without cartooning; Krishna teaches, Arjuna discerns.
hook_text: Rise beyond the forces that shape your nature.

title: Purushottama Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna describes the cosmic ashvattha tree and the Supreme Person beyond the perishable and imperishable realms.
composition_notes: Majestic inverted cosmic tree motif in sky over battlefield; Krishna points to transcendent reality, Arjuna inspired and focused.
hook_text: Cut illusion at its root—seek the Supreme.

title: Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna contrasts divine and demonic qualities, showing how character shapes destiny.
composition_notes: Dual moral contrast in tone and posture among warriors; Krishna and Arjuna in foreground choosing divine alignment. Keep realism and premium style.
hook_text: Destiny follows the qualities you cultivate daily.

title: Shraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna explains three kinds of faith and how intention influences worship, discipline, and action.
composition_notes: Symbolic triad of devotional expressions in background with Krishna teaching precise nuance; Arjuna thoughtful, absorbing final refinements.
hook_text: Faith is not what you claim—it is how you live.

title: Moksha Sanyasa Yoga
scene_brief: Krishna concludes the teaching; Arjuna's confusion ends, and he rises with clarity to perform his dharma.
composition_notes: Climactic heroic frame: Arjuna upright and resolute with Gandiva ready, Krishna serene and victorious at chariot helm, sunrise blazing over Kurukshetra.
hook_text: From doubt to destiny—the warrior finally chooses dharma.
